questions.question: What complaint did the circumcised believers in Jerusalem bring against the apostle Peter?

answers.text: He visited uncircumcised men and ate with them
He baptized people without asking the apostles
He stayed away from Jerusalem far too long

questions.question: While praying in Joppa, the apostle Peter saw a vision. What came down from heaven by its four corners?
When the Holy Spirit fell on the people in a Gentile man's house in Caesarea, how did Peter say it compared with the first believers?
After Peter explained how God worked among the Gentiles in Caesarea, what did the believers in Jerusalem do?

answers.text: They asked Peter to leave the city
They demanded the Gentiles be circumcised
